title: establish-performance-profile-signoff-guardrails-and-refresh-scheduler
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Define and implement operational guardrails, signoff criteria, and an automated refresh scheduler for Redwood-verified performance profiles (latency, throughput, cost) so that model onboarding is reproducible, auditable, and safe to roll into production. This ticket covers the PM-led policy and acceptance criteria; implementation tasks will be split into infra (ENG) and console/UX (DES/ENG) tickets.

Background: We currently publish performance profiles as part of model onboarding but lack a formalized signoff and scheduled refresh process. Profiles degrade over time as model updates, runtime changes, or workload shifts occur. Without consistent refresh and explicit signoff, customers can be routed to stale pins or encounter unexpected cost regressions.

Scope:
- Define mandatory metadata and signature fields for a published profile (version, anchor benchmarks, normalized cost, regional deltas, telemetry contract).
- Create a lightweight signoff flow: automated checks -> PM verification -> optional Security/Compliance signoff for private deployments.
- Design a refresh scheduler with configurable cadence and triage rules (age-based, drift-detected, telemetry-triggered).
- Establish rollback triggers and emergency deprecation flow for published profiles.
- Document exportable artifacts and audit trail requirements for SRE/Support.

Success criteria:
- A published profile must include the required metadata and pass automated verification checks before it appears in the catalog.
- The console shows profile age, last-verified build, and a recommended refresh date.
- Nightly/weekly scheduler runs and opens a verification PR for profiles that meet refresh rules.
- Profiles failing verification are marked EXPIRED and routed through a guarded rollback with clear customer-impact labels.

Out of scope: Full UI redesign of the profile catalog, extensive migration of legacy profiles (will be a follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Profiles include required metadata: model_id, model_version, runtime_hash, latency_p50/p90, tokens/sec, cost_per_1k_tokens, normalization_anchor, regional_variance
Automated verification pipeline returns pass/fail with artifact links (benchmarks, cost normalization runs)
PM signoff step is recorded in the profile audit trail with user, timestamp, and comments
Scheduler opens a staged refresh PR for profiles that meet age or drift thresholds
Console displays profile health: OK / WARNING / EXPIRED and recommends pin actions
tasks: Draft signoff policy and metadata schema (this ticket)
Work with ENG to add 'last_verified_build' and 'runtime_hash' to profile artifact (ENG-8421)
Define drift detection telemetry signals and thresholds (telemetry guild consult)
Create scheduler worker spec and backoff/triage rules (ENG task)
Design console indicators and compact refresh UX (DES task)
Implement automated verification pipeline that runs on scheduler PRs (CI - ENG)
Publish PM-run book: how to triage EXPIRED profiles and re-pin safely
